title: Permission Protocol receipt artifact envelope
description: The portable form of a receipt: the exact signed bytes, the signature, the digest, and the key identifier. Served publicly at https://app.permissionprotocol.com/r/<receipt_id>.json (signature-intact receipts only) and, tenant-authenticated, at GET /api/v1/receipts/<receipt_id>/artifact. Decode payload_bytes_b64 to obtain the object described by receipt-v2.json (canonicalization jcs_v2) or receipt-v3.json (jcs_v3). The envelope shape is the same for every receipt version; a jcs_v3 receipt's owner surfaces add request_json, request_commitment_salt_b64, summary, company_id, idem_key and input_hash.

receipt_version.description: Unsigned convenience copy of the signed receiptVersion (2 for jcs_v2, 3 for jcs_v3).

canonicalization.description: Unsigned convenience copy of the signed canonicalization. Verifiers dispatch on the value inside the signed bytes.

signed_payload_hash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the decoded payload bytes.

signature_b64.description: Base64 of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the 32-byte SHA-256 digest of the payload bytes.

payload_bytes_b64.description: Base64 of the exact canonical UTF-8 bytes that were hashed and signed.

request_json.description: jcs_v3 owner surfaces only (SPEC.md section 3.5), never the public artifact: the committed request, as its exact stored text. Opens requestCommitment with the salt.

request_commitment_salt_b64.description: jcs_v3 owner surfaces only: the 32-byte commitment salt, standard base64; null when the issuer no longer holds it.

summary.description: jcs_v3 owner surfaces only: the receipt's summary as the issuer stores it, null when it has none. Not signed: after opening, it must equal the committed receiptSummary (SPEC.md section 6.7).

company_id.description: jcs_v3 owner surfaces only: the receipt's companyId as the issuer stores it. Not signed: after opening, it must equal receiptBinding.companyId (SPEC.md sections 3.5 and 6.7).

idem_key.description: jcs_v3 owner surfaces only: the receipt's idemKey as the issuer stores it, null when it has none. Not signed: after opening, it must equal receiptBinding.idemKey.

input_hash.description: jcs_v3 owner surfaces only: the receipt's inputHash as the issuer stores it, null when it has none. Not signed: after opening, it must equal receiptBinding.inputHash.

attestation_artifact.description: Execute-lane receipts only (SPEC.md section 9.4): the execution attestation envelope, or null when the receipt has none. Verify it with SPEC.md section 9.5 after the receipt; schema/attestation-v1.json describes its decoded payload.

keys_url.description: Where the issuer publishes its key set. Present on the public artifact. Verifiers MAY pin their own copy instead.
